messages.content: Hey, Northline here — your weekly Tuesday check-in. Hope the week's been okay. Any readings to share today, or anything on your mind health-wise?
Well. Road's been drifted shut since Saturday. Nobody's come by, not even the mail. Just me and the dog rattling around in here.

That's a long stretch on your own. I hear you. I can't reach out to anyone for company on your behalf — that's outside what I'm able to do — but I'm glad you replied. Have you been keeping up with your medications, or had a chance to check your pressure?
Took my lisinopril this morning yeah. Checked pressure about an hour ago. Said 141 over 87.
Good, logging your lisinopril for today and that reading — 141/87. Are you feeling anything physically? Headache, chest tightness, anything at all?
No nothing like that. I'm fine. Just wish I had someone to talk to is all. I don't suppose you can help with that.

Not the way you deserve, and I won't pretend otherwise. I'll get your next check-in set for next week. If anything comes up before then — a reading that worries you, a symptom, anything with your meds — text here and I'll get eyes on it. Stay warm out there.

theme: lonely, just wanted to talk, nobody has been by since the snow
